text: The Claude adapter v0.101.0 answers a prompt of exactly `/usage` with every limit window (5-hour, weekly, per-model, extra usage), but only as markdown in the chat. It gets them from Claude Code's `get_usage` control request, which reads `/api/oauth/usage` with the OAuth token. coax could reach the numbers directly only by handling that token. On 2026-11-27 Jack judged showing account or limits in coax not worth it. Source: `isUsageCommandText` and `formatUsageResponse`.
